objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly in DHC VISION through creation, editing, release, distribution, archiving, versioning and revision.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected when creating a new document; can be changed or added in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Used to differentiate documents for clarity and evaluation options.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document; type abbreviations are listed for common document types.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to the document; assignment can be adapted to requirements.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Document property attribute maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property attribute maintained to link documents with IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and is maintained across document versions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and indicates the document state.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via User Groups.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute identifying the registered author; the creator is automatically confirmed in this field by default.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute assigning additional personal change rights; co-authors have no relevance within the release workflow.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute identifying users assigned to review the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute identifying users assigned to release the document, including translation.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects e-mail notification for assigned User Groups and persons when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects distribution of acknowledgement workflow tasks when the next version is released.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is calculated; updated for each newly released version.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined per document type for checking extended validity.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated validity expiry date based on Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for archiving documents, defined for each document type.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version used as the basis for translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which released translated documents are visible to authorized readers.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures within a framework or process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type used to document detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: form
objs.description: Supplement that can be added to work instructions.

objs.name: checklist
objs.description: Supplement that can be added to work instructions.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for each document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system to create a new document or to add additional information or attachments to a document.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File that can be uploaded to a pure object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office formats such as Excel, Word and PowerPoint used to generate new documents.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type used to supplement documents with additional information that is not subject to the main document release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and released with the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for amending an existing document, managed in the document cockpit.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person using the system, assigned to roles, groups, document responsibilities, workflow tasks and distribution.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented to provide appropriate functions according to area of application.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: Role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorizations, reader assignment, archive access, distribution and dashboards.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned to documents to provide read and change rights.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group that retains read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of User Groups and persons assigned to document distribution.

attributes.name: distribution_by_e_mail
attributes.description: Distribution type where assigned users are informed by e-mail when a new document version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Distribution type where assigned persons and users are requested to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by users that they have taken note of documents.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and shown through notifications.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification informing users about workflow tasks, change proposals, validity extension, distribution and acknowledgement.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that documents can be linked with.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that documents can be linked with.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that documents can be linked with.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data that documents can be linked with, such as IT applications.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of master data that documents can be linked with.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created before document validity expires and linked to the document to be checked.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate or override a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to revalidate invalidated documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report available for documents in the system.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter used to influence evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criterion
attributes.description: Criterion used to filter result lists.

attributes.name: traffic_light_status
attributes.description: Traffic light display used in reports to show validity or workflow status.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard displaying documents and document-related information.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.
